meta.name: business-intelligence
meta.description: Builds reporting and self-serve analytics that people actually use — metric trees, dashboard design, distribution, and the discipline that stops dashboards proliferating. Use this to build a dashboard or report, design a metrics framework, set up self-serve analytics, decide what to measure, or diagnose why reporting exists but nobody uses it or trusts it.

copy.tagline: 打造真正被团队使用的数据看板与指标体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果报表很多但没人看,想建起团队真正在用的分析体系。
copy.tagline_en: Build dashboards and metrics frameworks people actually use.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has dashboards nobody uses and you want metrics people trust.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 制作报表/仪表板时，会先问它支撑什么决策；若不会改变任何做法就不做。接着用指标树拆解指标，并遵循设计纪律：一屏一问题、必须对比、说明“好”的标准、注释异常。
howto.when: 当你要求构建仪表板/报表、设计指标框架等，或想诊断现有报告为什么没人用/不被信任时，Claude 会使用该技能。

say.text: 帮我按指标树拆解收入，找出主要驱动因素。
say.note: Claude 会按公式做指标树分解，给出各层关系。

say.text: 设计一个一屏只回答一个问题的订单仪表板。
say.note: Claude 会据此确定布局，并考虑对比和注释。

say.text: 我的报表没人看也没人信，帮我诊断。
say.note: Claude 会从决策基础、信任度和维护方面分析。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude asks what decision a report supports; if nothing would change, it won't build it. It decomposes metrics into a tree and follows dashboard discipline: one question per screen, always compare, say what good is, annotate anomalies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build a dashboard/report, design a metric framework, etc., or when you want to diagnose why existing reports are unused or untrusted.

say_en.text: Help me break down revenue with a metric tree and find the main drivers.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the tree and show relationships.

say_en.text: Design a one-screen dashboard that answers one question about orders.
say_en.note: Claude will decide layout, comparisons, and annotations.

say_en.text: My reports are unused and untrusted — help me diagnose.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze decision basis, trust, and maintenance.
